# Lumi Trades

> Lumi checks x402 sellers with real paid test-buys and keeps a signed receipt for each one.
> Sold per call to AI agents with x402 (USDC on Base or Stellar, or XRP, RLUSD or USDC on the XRP Ledger); no account or API key:
> x402 seller checks (allow / warn / block), vendor reports, signed test-buy receipts and a free vendor trust list
> built from real on-ledger test-buys of other pay-per-call endpoints. Informational test evidence, not financial advice.

## API docs (api.lumitrades.io)
- [API home](https://api.lumitrades.io/): overview, prices and the 402 flow
- [OpenAPI spec](https://api.lumitrades.io/openapi.json): every endpoint, parameter and response
- [Agent skill (skill.md)](https://api.lumitrades.io/skill.md): step-by-step guide for an agent to pay and call the API
- [x402 discovery](https://api.lumitrades.io/.well-known/x402): machine-readable list of paid resources and accepted payments
- [MCP server](https://api.lumitrades.io/mcp): remote MCP (streamable HTTP); local option `npx -y lumi-trades-mcp`
- [Trust methodology](https://api.lumitrades.io/v1/trust/methodology): how vendor trust scores are computed

- [For AI agents](https://lumitrades.io/agents/): what the API sells, prices, how to pay, MCP setup and FAQ

- [How the trust score works](https://lumitrades.io/trust-policy/#score): selection, no pay-to-rank, disclosures and the score method (also in es, pt, tr, ko, ja)

## Prices (USD per call)
### Lumi Trust
- `GET /v1/trust/check?url=`: x402 pay check: allow / warn / block with reasons, signed receipts, $0.02 per call
- `GET /v1/verdict?url=`: Pre-payment check, one label (delivered in recent checks / check first / recent checks failed / not enough data), $0.01 per call
- `GET /v1/trust/vendors/{id}/report`: Full report on one curated vendor (observation history, tx hashes, signed receipts), $0.02 per call
- `GET /v1/trust/vendors`: Vendor trust list and seller lookup, free
- `POST /v1/trust/receipts/verify`: Verify a signed test-buy receipt, free

## Seller monitoring and trust data feed (x402, 30-day plans, no auto-renew)
- Watch Free: $0. 1 endpoint: a daily quote check, no test-buys
- Watch: $5 per endpoint per 30 days. Hourly quote checks, a weekly test-buy, alerts, 30-day history and a status page
- Watch Pro: $20 per endpoint per 30 days. Quote checks every 15 minutes, daily test-buys on up to 3 chains within the test-buy budget, schema and latency alerts, 90-day history and a monthly report signed by Lumi's wallet
- Re-test pack: $6.50 one-time. 30 test-buys, used when you ask, valid 365 days
- Founder pack: $5.00 one-time. 24 test-buys, valid 365 days; first 10 sellers, one per company
- Audit: $99 one-time. One test-buy of every listed endpoint, with a full report signed by Lumi's wallet
- Feed Free: $0. 1,000 lookups a month per key (wallet-signature signup), returns the verdict only
- Feed credits: $1.50 per 1,000 lookups. Prepaid lookups on top of the free 1,000 a month; credits never expire
- Feed: $99 per 30 days. 100,000 bulk lookups, delta feed, full evidence and receipts
- Feed Pro: $199 per 30 days. 500,000 lookups, delta feed, licensed full snapshot export, status-change webhooks, receipts
- [Seller monitoring](https://api.lumitrades.io/v1/monitor) · [Trust data feed](https://api.lumitrades.io/v1/feed) · [Feed license](https://api.lumitrades.io/v1/feed/license)

## Paying
- Pay address: always take Lumi's pay address (payTo) from the live 402 payment response or /.well-known/x402, never from transaction history or a past transfer.

- [Vendor trust list as JSON](https://api.lumitrades.io/v1/trust/vendors): free
